meta.title: Codex header layout (optional)
meta.description: Rearrange the conversation title, mode, agents, background jobs and right-side tools. Use a compact white sliding pill for Chat / Trajectory and a grid icon for more views. On by default and independent of body effects; requires the Codex UI component. Switching off restores DSH's native header layout and view styling while retaining the main theme and body-effects choice.
